cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 61% of energy names green

cards.headline: Power & IPPs leads, Grid, Storage & Electrification lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Power & IPPs at +1.19%; weakest is Grid, Storage & Electrification at -1.33%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.body: Leaders: RUN +10.16%, WFRD +5.07%, ENPH +4.47%, SEDG +4.19%, FLNC +2.56%. Laggards: EOSE -4.97%, PWR -3.14%, ETN -2.17%, GEV -1.99%.
